title: Nomenclature.
bodyText: The controlled substances listed or to be listed in the schedules in sections 329-14, 329-16, 329-18, 329-20, and 329-22 are included by whatever official, common, usual, chemical, or trade name designated.
bodyHtml: [§329-12]  Nomenclature.  The controlled substances listed or to be listed in the schedules in sections 329-14, 329-16, 329-18, 329-20, and 329-22 are included by whatever official, common, usual, chemical, or trade name designated. [L 1972, c 10, pt of §1]
